# model__prediction__generic__null-model

> Dataset-agnostic null forecaster for EPISERVE: repeats the mean, median or last value of a trailing window over the forecast horizon, with empirical q10/q90. No training, no weights, no network, no GPU.

## Onboarding

- [Contributor Guide](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/onboarding/contributor-guide): progressive path from Python basics to a first pull request.
- [Staff Engineer Guide](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/onboarding/staff-engineer-guide): decision log, failure modes, tradeoffs.
- [Executive Guide](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/onboarding/executive-guide): capability map, risk and cost.
- [Product Manager Guide](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/onboarding/product-manager-guide): user journeys, limitations, FAQ.

## Architecture

- [Execution Pipeline](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/02-architecture/execution-pipeline): main() step by step and every failure path.
- [Time Axis and Target Handling](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/02-architecture/series-handling): datetime/timedelta/numeric/string axes and gap policy.
- [The Null Forecast](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/02-architecture/null-forecast): point statistic, empirical quantiles, clamping.
- [Model Card and Config Validation](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/02-architecture/model-card-and-validation): fdo.json as the source of truth.

- [Configuration](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/01-getting-started/configuration): the four parameters and their bounds.
- [Local Development](https://the-episerve-consortium.github.io/model__prediction__generic__null-model/01-getting-started/local-development): run, test, build, publish.
